trickyParts:
Goldmark's Text value never holds its line's own line ending (parser.go stops at \n and trims), so the old TrimSuffix("\n") on the decoded value only ever ate a decoded 
 before a break; trimming now runs on the raw segment before decoding.

The engine's import (remarkSoftBreakAsSpace) turns every line feed in a text node into a space, a decoded 
 included, but an image alt is an attribute and keeps it.
Go's html table lacks ≪⃒ and ≫⃒ (src/html/entity.go TODO); characterReferenceAt decodes them itself.
The image address now doubles a backslash before ASCII punctuation outside a table too, in one pass with the table pipe escape, so nothing is doubled twice.
